text: In accordance with Section 3.C. of the Terms of Reference of the Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee, the Committee will elect a member as Vice-Chair.

The Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee: 1. Elected Abinaya Chandrabalan as Vice Chair of the Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee for a term of office ending upon the completion of the Committee's mandate or the end of the current City Council term, whichever comes first.
